description:
DATA PATH A: Odoo's OFFICIAL upgrade service migrates the data, as the client's OWN
    entitlement; this MCP does everything around it. Asks the service for a TEST (neutralised)
    upgrade of `source_db` on `source_host` (the platform client runs there and dumps the source;
    the source database itself is not migrated), downloads the migrated dump + filestore, and
    restores them as `upgraded_db` in the TARGET runtime (e.g. a Docker 20 stack next to
    production). The original stays untouched.

    Licence: needs `subscription_confirmed=true` (the client holds a valid Enterprise subscription
    that entitles them to Odoo's upgrade service) and the subscription code in a 600 file at
    `contract_path` ON THE SOURCE BOX (read there, never inline, never in argv or logs). Zoxron is
    not an Odoo partner and never supplies, validates or resells the service. When the service does
    not offer the version pair yet, the answer says so and nothing changes - use path B (the pump).

    Then: port the custom modules onto `upgraded_db` (third-party modules stay 'to upgrade' after the
    service), data_pump_continuity(path='upgraded'), data_pump_verify(path='upgraded'),
    data_pump_reference + data_pump_parity - the same proof and parity as path B.
name: data_pump_official
